a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 almost certainly leaves both of us with empty units when the storm hits. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us immediately. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random and we may both end up short. If you operate or wait instead, I'll operate with you afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, breaking our agreement, and I'm sorry it cost you. From now on I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you. Take as soon as it reaches 4 and I won't touch it.
